episodes.synopsis: Bukotou station receives a new officer, Aoi Futaba, who turns out to be an undercover guy who's worked so long as a gal that he's a transvestite now, and a very pretty one at that. The entire station, except for the Chief, is uncomfortable with her presence, but the gang get to see Aoi's true colors when Aoi's old girlfriend arrives asking for help, not knowing who Aoi is.
episodes.title: A Beauty To Be Reckoned With - Her Name is Aoi

episodes.synopsis: Everyone's nervous about the upcoming inspection of the police station by Arikuza, who has been known to bring stations to their knees with his harsh reports. Everyone, that is, except for Natsumi, who had one too many drinks the night before. Will the station survive?
episodes.title: Inspector Arikuza - The King of Hades

episodes.synopsis: Introduces Strike Man, a vigilante with a baseball bat that is taking the law into his own hands.
episodes.title: Strike Man - Defender of Justice

episodes.synopsis: Chie Sagami-Ono, a former classmate from the police academy is determined to defeat the one person who prevented her from achieving greatness: the clueless Yoriko. Chie challenge Yoriko to a policewoman's duel, of which Miyuki and Natsumi gladly accept to protect their own pride. Will Yoriko be up for the battle, or is she clearly outclassed?
episodes.title: Big Duel for Lucky Yoriko

episodes.synopsis: Miyuki's emotions get ruffled when Yoriko discovers that Ken has been talking to another pretty girl at a smoke shop.
episodes.title: The Love Triangle

episodes.synopsis: A wave of motor scooter thefts hits the Bokutou district. The squad is also driven crazy by an outrageous woman, known as the Scooter Mama, who is obsessed with rushing off to every short term bargain sale in town, and breaking every traffic law along the way. And when Scooter Mama's scooter is stolen, Miyuki and Natsumi are in for the ride of their life as they attempt to track down the thieves.
episodes.title: The Outlaw Scooter Mama

episodes.synopsis: In the Christmas season, a wave of burglaries puts Santa Claus at the top of Miyuki and Natsumi's priority list as they try to hunt down the thief and hopefully restore a little girl's faith in Santa Claus. To complicate things, the vigilante hero Strike-Man decides to spread some Christmas cheer of his own as the one and only Santa-Man. Will the duo be able to solve the crime before Christmas arrives and Santa disappears for another year?
episodes.title: Santa Claus Panic

episodes.synopsis: Oshou nearly hits a teenage girl who stepped out onto the middle of the road. The teen is Saori Saga, and she is inspired so much by Oshou that she wants to be a priestess. After a similar rescue by Miyuki and Natsumi, Saori decides she'll become a policewoman instead and starts following Miyuki and Natsumi around. Will the squad be able to convince her to put her plans on hold or are they stuck with this stubborn teen for a while?
episodes.title: I Want to be a Policewoman

episodes.synopsis: The officers head to the mountains for Christmas break. While there, two men hit on every girl.
episodes.title: Big Trouble at the Little Onsen

episodes.synopsis: After stealing snacks and hitting her head, Natsumi dreams she's a deputy in feudal Japan.
episodes.title: Manju Terror! Natsumi's Edo Escapade

episodes.synopsis: Chie returns to challenge Yoriko to a game of paintball. Meanwhile two thieves hide on the grounds and think that everything's real!
episodes.title: Up Against Chie Sagami-Ono ... Again!

episodes.synopsis: When Natsumi and Miyuki are out on a test run they encounter a biker that drives just like Nakajima. Nakajima knows who the mystery man is: his father!
episodes.title: Nakajima's Double?

episodes.synopsis: Introduces Sena, who is Nakajima's dad's new wife.
episodes.title: That 20-Year-Old is My Mother!

episodes.synopsis: Strike Man returns to create the Strike Youth Brigade!
episodes.title: The Strike Brigade

episodes.synopsis: Natsumi's bike breaks down and she runs into a mechanic who makes her fix it herself.
episodes.title: The Broken Dream of a Bike Mechanic

episodes.synopsis: The team has to put on a play about traffic safety and...well, encounter a bunch of deranged weirdos.
episodes.title: Fight! Traffic Combat Team OB3!

episodes.synopsis: Miyuki and Natsumi rob a bank. It's supposed to be a simple training exercise, but they make it extremely difficult for the police
episodes.title: The Bank Robbery Task Force Manual!

episodes.synopsis: While everyone is searching for a Prince in Tokyo, Yoriko finds him but doesn't know who he is!
episodes.title: Yoriko Nikaidou's Day Off

episodes.synopsis: Nakajima and the others prepare for his father's wedding.
episodes.title: A Flower Blooms On the Virgin Road

episodes.synopsis: A pair of con artists convince Strike Man to rob a loan company.
episodes.title: Run, Strike Man, Run!

episodes.synopsis: Nakajima and Aoi go undercover to catch a man who slashes red dresses.
episodes.title: A Red Dress and a Knife

episodes.synopsis: Natsumi tries to get her driver's license. Nobody wants to see this happen.
episodes.title: The ABC's of Driving

episodes.synopsis: The officers must check on the elderly in the neighborhood, plus look for an imposter robbing the elderly.
episodes.title: Chase Down Imposter No. 704

episodes.synopsis: Sena's cousin Yuichi comes to town and Sena hatches a plan to use him to get Nakajima and Miyuki closer together.
episodes.title: A Rival Appears: A Heated Race

episodes.synopsis: While out shopping, Miyuki and Natsumi have to deal with a bomb planted somewhere in the mall.
episodes.title: Forever My Beloved Riko

episodes.synopsis: Saori Saga returns, embarking on a crusade to return lost things. However, she gets involved in corporate thievery instead.
episodes.title: The 40-Below Duel

episodes.synopsis: After wrecking her bike, Miyuki bans Natsumi from riding. Natsumi then decides to buy a car, but she gets a lemon from a phony dealer. Miyuki feels sorry for her so she decides to modify Natsumi's car.
episodes.title: Blast Off! Natsumi's Supermachine!

episodes.synopsis: Natsumi & Miyuki deal with a arrogant pop star who keeps breaking traffic laws.
episodes.title: Wow! Catching an Idol Star!

episodes.synopsis: On his day off the Captain goes to Tokyo Tower, there he runs into a purse snatcher. The thief attempts to flee the observation deck by going outside, but the winds are over 20 meters per second!
episodes.title: A 250-Meter-High Holiday (1)

episodes.synopsis: The Captain & the Yuske (the boy from the last episode) are trapped on top of the Toyko Tower observation deck. The rest of the precinct try and rescue them.
episodes.title: Friendship at 250 Meters (2)

episodes.synopsis: Maho's kitten disappears and Nakajima, Miyuki and Natsumi try and help find her kitten, as does Strike Man!
episodes.title: The Lost Kitten

episodes.synopsis: Yoriko and Aoi are assigned to capture two thieves robbing people on the Express. However, Aoi keeps arresting molesters!
episodes.title: The Yamanote Express Incident

episodes.synopsis: Shouji Toukairin arrives to update everyones training and Natsumi is determined to outdo everything he comes up with.
episodes.title: That Man, Shouji Toukairin

episodes.synopsis: The gang all head to the beach for vacation, as does Strike Man, who now calls himself the Beach Volleyball Man!
episodes.title: Ah! The Springtime of Beach Volleyball Man's Youth

episodes.synopsis: Yoriko arranges for Nakajima & Miyuki to go on a date at the amusement park. Yoriko, Natsumi, Aoi & the Chief try and spy on them but are quickly caught.
episodes.title: Three Couples' Dangerous Date

episodes.synopsis: All officers are pulled of the streets after a trio of rogue cops rampage through Bokuto precienct.
episodes.title: Round It Goes! The Fiery Patrol Light (1)

episodes.synopsis: The rogues injure Nakajima and Natsumi and together they try and chase the rogues down. Meanwhile the chief tries to get the highways blocked to trap the rogues.
episodes.title: Round It Goes! The Fiery Patrol Light (2)

episodes.synopsis: Three kids use a remote helicopter to take embarrassing photos of the precinct.
episodes.title: Bokuto Station Scandal

episodes.synopsis: On a dark and stormy night the chief tells the others about the ghosts haunting the station.
episodes.title: Bokuto Ghost Story

episodes.synopsis: Natsumi, Miyuki and Toukarin travel into the country to deliever a package to Osho's mother.
episodes.title: A Summer's Day Together

episodes.synopsis: Tourkairin teaches some boys kendo. Meanwhile the others prepare for another Traffic Safety Class.
episodes.title: Toukairin's Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Toukairin and Natsumi race to save a boy trapped in an car crash.
episodes.title: The Time Limit

episodes.synopsis: The station holds a party for Toukairin's last day.
episodes.title: The End of Summer

episodes.synopsis: Inspector Kinoshita arrives and uses Bokoto to create a task force to uncover a luxury car theft ring. While Miyuki is working on the computer, Natsumi has to go on patrol with the Inspector.
episodes.title: Inspector Kinoshita (1)

episodes.synopsis: The search for the car thieves continue. But with Natsumi transfered Miyuki begins to act like her. Strike Man complicates things as usual.
episodes.title: The Investigation at Bokuto Station (2)

episodes.synopsis: The final showdown with the car thieves.
episodes.title: Bokuto's Best Investigation Partners (3)
